reason: Real Windows final UAT now proves BOOTSTRAP/MATRIX_READY/ELEMENT_READY/ELECTRON_BOOT/DESKTOP_READY/UI_READY and the post-install receipt are GREEN, but the production login screen has no end-user Matrix credential acquisition path. Public Matrix registration is intentionally disabled and Personal Access is a separate OWNER/TESTER entitlement authority, so a fresh human installation reaches a valid Element login surface without any credential it can use. Close only this release blocker by reusing Synapse's official shared-secret registration protocol through the already-trusted local Desktop API/session boundary, while preserving Element as the sole interactive Matrix login authority and preserving the existing Personal Access entitlement gate after login.
requiredClosure: Extract the already-production-used Synapse shared-secret HMAC registration mechanism from facebookPersonalMessengerMautrixAdapter.js into one reusable repository service; do not duplicate or invent another registration algorithm.

Add an end-user Matrix identity service that uses the same YANCE_MATRIX_REGISTRATION_SHARED_SECRET_FILE and YANCE_MATRIX_BASE_URL authority, persists only non-secret local identity receipt metadata, and fails closed after one successfully provisioned local human identity per installation.

Expose GET/POST /api/desktop/matrix-local-identity only under the existing loopback + API-session local-control boundary. Do not add public Matrix registration and do not exempt any /api/app/v2 product route from Personal Access.

POST accepts a user-selected localpart/password, delegates account creation to Synapse shared-secret registration, discards the returned Matrix access token, and never returns access tokens or persisted passwords to the renderer.
Expose the two local identity operations through the existing r32StoreBridge/preload IPC authority and register their exact command paths in the existing manifest/inventory; no second IPC framework.

On the current Yance login surface, when no local Matrix identity exists, show a first-use local account setup for username/password; after successful creation, show the exact Matrix user id and route the user to the existing Element login form with the password they just chose. Do not implement Matrix login in YanceLogin and do not call /_matrix/client from renderer code.

After login, preserve the existing PersonalAccessSurface behavior exactly: OWNER stays permanently usable when its existing secure owner credential is present; a friend/TESTER submits the existing installation-bound request and is usable only after OWNER approval and ACTIVE grant.

Preserve enable_registration=false, UIFeature.registration=false, login_for_welcome=true, the sealed Element 8080 binding, activation responder readiness, session restore, and current post-install PASS semantics.

Add permanent local regressions for clean identity creation, duplicate provisioning rejection, invalid input, Synapse error fail-closed behavior, existing identity status, no renderer Matrix protocol, public registration still disabled, exact IPC inventory, and materialized UAT startup/login reachability.
